final: SELECT scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor, AVG(scans.scancount) as avg_scancount, AVG(scans.pressratio) as avg_pressratio FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(scans.pressratio) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(scans.pressratio) DESC LIMIT 10
